profile.name: CAN总线BLF日志记录器
profile.description: 用于将CAN总线消息和错误帧记录为BLF（二进制日志）文件的软件记录器，可生成与Vector工具兼容的日志，常用于车辆网络、嵌入式通信和实验台架中的总线数据采集与离线分析。
profile.description_en: A software logger that records CAN bus messages and error frames into BLF (Binary Logging File) format, producing logs compatible with Vector tools. It is commonly used for vehicle network testing, embedded communication experiments, and bench-side bus data capture for offline analysis.

registry.name: Blf Writer
registry.description: BLF Writer是一款实验执行&合成设备，主要功能包括停止、日志记录。支持Signal, Slot, file size等操作。
